title: IPCC AR6: 2019 annual means were 410 ppm CO2, 1,866 ppb methane, and 332 ppb nitrous oxide
summary: The 2021 Working Group I Summary for Policymakers states those 2019 annual averages and says the increases since about 1750 are unequivocally from human activities.
body: The IPCC Working Group I Summary for Policymakers, in the 2021 physical-science report, says in statement A.1.1 that observed increases in well-mixed greenhouse-gas concentrations since around 1750 are unequivocally caused by human activities. It says concentrations continued to increase after the measurements reported in the previous assessment, reaching annual averages in 2019 of 410 parts per million for carbon dioxide, 1,866 parts per billion for methane, and 332 parts per billion for nitrous oxide. Later NOAA monthly means are later measurements. They are not this 2019 assessment line.
